valhalla.title: Valhalla
valhalla.intro: The same content, in every look this site has worn since 2015. Each theme reads the current content, so nothing here is out of date. Only the haircuts are.
valhalla.how: Every theme reads one file, /content/site.json, published with this site. Add a project once and it shows up in all of them without rebuilding any. Each theme’s own code is built once and then left alone.
valhalla.keepers: Tapi and Chiyo keep the place. Click them; they talk.
